result.title: Gumbel Substitution: Removing Sampler Drift from RL Without Trusting the Sampler
result.summary: When RL rollouts come from untrusted samplers on arbitrary hardware, precision and checkpoint lag, the sampling distribution $q$ differs from the trainer's policy $p$, and training on the sampler's tokens adds a drift term equal to supervised fine-tuning toward $q$. Published corrections (TIS, MIS, IcePop, score centering, GSPO, CISPO) all need $q(y)$, which a permissionless sampler reports and can misreport. We introduce Gumbel substitution. The coordinator fixes public Gumbel noise for every token position, bit-identical across GPUs, and the sampler draws $y=\arg\max(\ell^q+G)$. The trainer recomputes $v^*=\arg\max(\ell^p+G)$, the token its own policy would have drawn with the same noise, and scores $v^*$ in the sampler's context. For a sampler that follows the protocol, $v^*$ is an exact sample from $p$ given the prefix, so the drift vanishes in expectation for any $q$, without sampler-reported probabilities. We measure the residual left by the deployed heads, bound the one added by admission gates, and state what an adaptive sampler can still do. The same comparison gives a per-token match rate that admits and pays samplers. In the lab, on a 9B model with the same head on both sides, the expected drift of uncorrected training is at least 170 to 4,800 times that of substitution. On a 2B model under strong mismatch, uncorrected training collapses while substitution stays stable, comparable to MIS with score centering given the true $q$. On a permissionless network, a 9B model was trained for 158 optimizer steps on 15.75B tokens from heterogeneous samplers, with no skipped step and 1.21% of tokens substituted; it improved on all eight held-out benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出「Gumbel substitution」：协调方为每个 token 位置固定跨 GPU 位一致的公共 Gumbel 噪声，训练方在相同噪声下重算自身策略会采样的 token 并据此打分，从而无需采样器上报概率即可消除任意采样分布 q 引致的漂移，并给出逐 token 匹配率用于采样器准入与支付，在 2B/9B 模型及异构无许可采样器网络上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心问题是「不信任采样器时如何修正 rollout 分布偏差」，公共 Gumbel 噪声耦合与逐 token 匹配率可能可供核查用于分布式随机 latent 采样的状态一致性检验或轨迹贡献分配；但论文不涉及视觉输入与 latent 推理状态，迁移可行性需研究者自行判断。
